name: mailbox-disconnected
subject: A mailbox was disconnected from your Permaily account

blocks.text: A mailbox was disconnected from your Permaily account. Its address no longer accepts mail, and its mail is being deleted.
Turn forwarding to it off in Gmail, or Gmail will tell you that forwarding fails.
If this wasn't you, sign in at app.permaily.com, sign out the devices you don't know, and write to support@permaily.com.
